sources.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D hand-drawn fighting game COMPLETE BODY animation cels, 8 cels in4columns x2rows, transparent background no words. Input1 is approved João complete-body master, input2 is face reference. Preserve face identity, rectangular glasses, black backward cap, dark wavy hair, faint goatee/moustache, white open rolled-sleeve shirt over black T-shirt, blue baggy jeans, gray sneakers, same stocky youthful body proportions and bold clean ink/cel shading. Animate a fighting SOMERSAULT ROLL physically curling into a compact ball while traveling RIGHT. Eight different complete-body drawings ordered: 1 lowguard load deeply bent knees; 2 spring forward and curl tightly knees against chest, arms wrapped across shins; 3 compact somersault body head toward top-right boots bottom-left; 4 same tightly curled whole-body rotating clockwise90degrees headlower-right bootupper-left; 5 tightlycurled headbottom-left bootupper-right, showback/capnaturally; 6 tightlycurled headupper-left bootlower-right; 7 unfolding fromroll to lowlanding, one hand braceddown; 8 rising back to original combatguard. Exact same anatomical lengths in each frame, rotation comes from newdrawings not stretched limbs. Keep toes elbows fullyinside each equalcell. Layout approx1792x896,448cells, guardheight~380px, centerx224, groundedfeetbaseline424. Compressed ball shoulddiameter~250px not enlargedhead. Ball-centered cels3-6 centered at224,235 relativecell. Actual transparent background, no floor, shadow, electricity, aura, movement lines, text, borders. Power effects will be rendered independently. Everycel includes entirecharacter, do notcrop/paste face onto ball. Never use 3D, polygonmodels, chibi, differentface, omittedglasses, or separatefloatinglimbs.

Create a professional hand-drawn 2D arcade fighting-game VISUAL EFFECTS sprite atlas, transparent RGBA background, no characters, no lettering. 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly SIXTEEN separately isolated effect drawings, ample transparent margins, every cell same dimensions, no overlaps across cells. Style: classic 1990s Japanese cel-animated fighting games, energetic hand-inked brush shapes, sharp flowing tapered tips, intricate white-hot cores, pale neutral silver-grey translucent energy, dark cool charcoal thin ink edges. MONOCHROME NEUTRAL effects for tinting in engine, no saturated colors. Avoid primitive geometric polygons, wireframes, spokes, sun icons or star/wheel symbols. Rows 1 AND 2 (eight frames in reading order) are animation of an UPPERCUT ENERGY CRESCENT rising from lower left around the right side then curling left near top. Each drawing upright tall, approx 230 px wide and 340 px tall, consistent physical extent and registration, open to the LEFT. Thin sweeping wisps below, thick brilliant tip near upper right, hollow left inside curve, layered swoosh brush texture, shape follows a vigorous rising punch. Frame 1 charge/short opening wisp; frame 2 crescent lengthening; frames 3-5 strongest full tall crescent; frame 6 crescent breaking up; frames 7-8 fading curling wisps. Row 3 (four frames) is an animated empty ELECTRIC SPIN AURA RING, circle diameter roughly 300px, transparent hollow center, ragged brush rotation swipes and short wild lightning branches around perimeter, varied rotating animation phase, organic not perfect circle, thin, no central symbol or solid disc. Row 4 (four frames) is an animated small DIRECTIONAL POWER RELEASE / MUZZLE PUFF firing to the RIGHT: fluid short curling energy brush wisps, a bright small core with tapered streaks flowing right, then dissipating shards; no radiating sunbeams or repeating spokes. Every effect must remain fully inside its cell. Complete polished game-ready bitmap effects on transparent background.

processing: Lossless source conversion and explicit frame registration only; no body deformation or generated inbetweens. See tools/pack_roll_v10.py and tools/pack_power_cels_v10.py.
